Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the reporting of traffic conditions during session meetings of the house and senate transportation committees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to traffic reports during session meetings of thehouse and senate transportation committees; and adding a new section tochapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that public transportation policy decisionscan be improved by keeping legislators regularly informed of currenttraffic congestion, safety, and service level conditions affecting thetraveling public around the state. During the legislative session, every meeting of the transportationcommittees of the senate and house of representatives must begin witha summary of the significant morning traffic conditions, includingferry operations, for that day. The report must include, but not belimited to, roadway and ferry operations in King, Pierce, Snohomish,Thurston, Clark, and Spokane counties. The report must last at leastthree minutes and must, whenever possible, include footage voluntarily p. 1 SB 6545supplied from television news media.
